question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

The teacher will / certainly help you / if you will / ask her.
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"if you will."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The use of** "will"** after** "if"** is redundant and unnecessary.
 
• The error is a grammatical redundancy.
 
• The use of **"will"** in this context is not needed as** "if" **already implies a conditional action.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence**: *"The teacher will certainly help you **if you**__ ask her."*
